snippet.title: Driver's Eyes will be playable in MAME 0.276 (Namco System 21 based arcade)
snippet.description:
Driver's Eyes was an ambitious early Namco 3D racer with panoramic / 3 screen display.  It uses a configuration of 3 Namco System 21 derived PCB stacks.  While I added support for MAME to run all 3 screens at once many years ago I wasn't able to understand the communication chip, so the side screens didn't work. SailorSat has now managed to figure out how that chip works, allowing all 3 screens to operate.  It also allows some other Namco games to run in linked configurations with multiple instances of MAME.

There are still some video glitches (flickering polygons) at times, but the game is otherwise now fully playable.  The emulation stays at over 100% on a i9-13900KS with no overclocking, the footage here was recorded in realtime.
